# Pack: tickets

Generic tracker tickets from Redmine, any JIRA, or both, read from the records cache the tickets downloader writes.

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | `context` |
| Version | `0.1.0` |
| Needs a credential to publish | no |
| Okg modules it needs | `document_starter`, `person`, `extraction` |
| Packs it needs | none |

## In which bundles

- Default in: [`cluster-manager`](../bundles/cluster-manager.md)
- Optional in: none

Add it to an instance with `archi add tickets`.

## Sources

- `tickets.tickets`

## Questions

`archi init` asks these. Answer one with `--answer tickets_<id>=VALUE`.

| Id | Type | Required | Default | Prompt |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `base_url` | `string` | yes |  | Tracker URL |
| `system` | `string` | no | `redmine` | Tracker system name (lowercase) |

## Credentials

The pack reads these environment variables. Only the names are listed. Set them in the environment of the shell that runs ingestion (okg and the downloaders): archi does not pass values from the instance's `.env` to ingestion.

- `REDMINE_API_KEY`
- `JIRA_API_TOKEN`

## Freshness limits

`archi doctor` compares each source's age with its limit.

| Source | Longest acceptable age |
|---|---|
| `tickets.tickets` | `24h` |

## Link coverage targets

| Name | From | Edge | To | Direction | Minimum share | Severity |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `ticket_author` | `tracker_ticket` | `reported_by` | `person` | out | 0.9 | warn |

## Invariants

The pack owns these checks. They leave with it.

| Name | Severity | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `tickets_coverage` | error | The tickets source must have live tickets. Required live subtypes: tracker_ticket. A missing one means the input was empty or the connector regressed. |
